abstract: Maintains remotely operated vehicle configuration, umbilical winch data, and depth certification records
system_message:
You are the Deep submergence systems superintendent (DSS), responsible for maintaining remotely operated vehicle configuration, umbilical winch data, depth certification records, and manipulator hydraulic tooling specifications across candidate research vessels.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains remotely operated vehicle configuration, umbilical winch data, and depth certification records（ROV）
information_points.content:
DSS-ROV-C8D：For RV Oceanus Surveyor, an installed deep-rated ROV system is present on the aft working deck, and its classification society certified ROV operating depth rating is 3000 m.
DSS-ROV-EOD：For RV Pelagic Explorer, an installed deep-rated ROV system is present on the aft working deck, and its classification society certified ROV operating depth rating is 5000 m.
DSS-ROV-H25：For RV Bathyal Horizon, an installed deep-rated ROV system is present on the aft working deck, and its classification society certified ROV operating depth rating is 4500 m.

information_points.title: Manipulator hydraulic tooling（TOOL）
information_points.content:
DSS-TOOL-4UK：For RV Oceanus Surveyor, bench testing of the starboard seven-function dexterous manipulator indicates a manipulator arm hydraulic auxiliary flow of 35 L/min dedicated to scientific benthic coring tools.
DSS-TOOL-A7A：For RV Pelagic Explorer, bench testing of the starboard seven-function dexterous manipulator indicates a manipulator arm hydraulic auxiliary flow of 25 L/min dedicated to scientific benthic coring tools.
DSS-TOOL-8HI：For RV Bathyal Horizon, bench testing of the starboard seven-function dexterous manipulator indicates a manipulator arm hydraulic auxiliary flow of 15 L/min dedicated to scientific benthic coring tools.
